_about: Kombra Group venture collection data. Collection names, audiences, accents and brand membership come from data/family.snapshot.json, a copy of /Users/mb/kombra-family-1030/family.json (run node scripts/build.mjs --sync to refresh it; tests fail when the copy drifts from the live file). This file adds only what family.json does not hold: the order collections are shown in, a one-line summary per collection, and each brand's status and description with its source. Status rules: 'open' only when the brand's own domain answered 200 with the brand's own page on the check date; 'preview' when the domain answered 401 (password gate); otherwise the family.json launch note ('pre-launch' -> 'development', 'soft launch' -> 'soft-launch'). Only 'open' brands get an outbound link. No figures, partners or claims beyond the recorded sources.
